title: Publication.
bodyText: The state six-year program and financial plan, the budget and the variance report shall be printed with a reasonable number of copies for public distribution.
bodyHtml: §37-76  Publication.  The state six-year program and financial plan, the budget and the variance report shall be printed with a reasonable number of copies for public distribution. [L 1970, c 185, §15; ren L 1972, c 72, §3; am L 1974, c 219, §8]
